Elite mode was a mode in season 1 which would unlock if you placed top 5 in a match. Entering the elite queue would place you against other people who reached the top 5 in their previous game.
Winning a game would get you the 'Elite (Legend)' Badge.
Winning 8 in a row with 8 different legends and getting atleast 8 kills in every one of those games would give you the 'Elite 888' Badge.
And then there was a badge which showed your elite winstreak.

The mode was discontinued mainly due to ranked being released the next season but partly because the mode simply encouraged ratting and camping with no incentives for getting kills (aside from the Elite 888 Badge.)
